Good morning. **Martin** here again, delighted to be bringing you the news
that matters for your Friday morning. Rejoice, for a long weekend is nearly
here.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we look at an outburst from **Donald Trump**
that was vile and dangerous even by his wretched standards, a broadside
against Somali immigrants in Minnesota and a call for "the people of
Minnesota" to "fight back." When calls for violence are coming from inside the
(White) House, America is really in trouble. Trump also spouted vile
Islamophobic abuse at **Abdul El-Sayed** , the Democratic candidate for Senate
in Michigan, who duly faced similar bile from **Mike Rogers** , his GOP
opponent, on the debate stage in Grand Rapids.

Then we'll look at a bombshell report from the _New York Times_ , about how a
close aide to Ambassador to Israel **Mike Huckabee** is co-opting embassy
practice to his own, openly pro-Israel ends. There was also a Senate debate in
Georgia, and the Nobel Peace Prize goes to someone who has called out Israel's
genocide in Gaza. Let's read in.

# 'Fight Back, Minnesota'

The president of the United States is trying to start a race war in Minnesota.
This is not hyperbole. This is [what he
posted](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2108294378792116548) on Thursday:

> **" The once Great State of Minnesota is being taken over by Somali
> Immigrants. There is Violence, Murder, and Mayhem all over the State. The
> people of Minnesota must fight back. You have been robbed, and abandoned by
> your State Government. Your Governor is an incompetent thief who doesn't
> want to get involved. He just wants to get out of town with as much as he
> can steal, and then, lead a quiet life. The Somalians should not be allowed
> to get away with what they are doing. They view you as weak and stupid
> people. Fight back Minnesota, fight back! If you need, the Federal
> Government will come to your rescue. Governor Tim Walz, and Mayor of
> Minneapolis, Jacob Frey, must immediately ask for Federal help -- and leave
> the rest to us! President DONALD J. TRUMP"**

Doubtless, defenders and apologists for the fascist in the White House will
claim that when he writes "fight" he really means "vote," that he is merely
using typical exaggeration to encourage Minnesota voters to kick Democrats out
of congressional office and reject Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan for Senate and Amy
Klobuchar for governor next month.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

If so, rubbish. Trump knows Republicans are losing and he is taking action
accordingly. Remember Jan. 6, 2021? That dreadful day, speaking to his
supporters outside the White House, Trump told the mob to **" fight like
hell"** to block certification of his conclusive defeat by Joe Biden in the
2020 election. [Nine
deaths](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/01/05/us/politics/jan-6-capitol-
deaths.html) were linked to the riot that followed. Trump already has blood on
his hands.

That concerned a presidential election. He has form when it comes to midterms
too.
